summary: Banalia territory (Tshopo), north of Kisangani along the RN4 towards Buta, is not an active conflict zone: no rebel or militia group is known to control territory as of 2026. The PNC is assessed as controller of Banalia town and of the Bengamisa and Banalia secteurs, with FARDC detachments in the chief-town and around the Panga gold-mining area in the east. Assessments rest on default state presence; web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for the town and low elsewhere.

zones.description: Banalia town (Saraevo/Afilondo, Lukelo and Dr Sharp health areas) on the Aruwimi river
zones.evidence: Territorial chief-town of Banalia on the Kisangani-Buta road (RN4); seat of the territorial administration with a PNC commissariat and a small FARDC detachment. No armed group is known to hold or tax the town; insecurity consists of crime and occasional unrest. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment based on background knowledge.

zones.description: Secteur de Bengamisa villages along the Kisangani-Banalia road and old Yangambi road (Bengamisa health zone)
zones.evidence: Rural villages just north of Kisangani along the RN4 and the old Yangambi road, far from eastern frontlines and with no reported armed-group activity; state police posts and customary/administrative authorities cover the area. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment based on background knowledge.

zones.description: Secteur de Banalia rural villages (Aruwimi/RN4 axis, Mangi, Loila, Zambeke, Mosanda, Babise)
zones.evidence: Sparsely populated forest villages of Banalia secteur with no reported armed-group control; occasional poaching and banditry along forest tracks but state police and administration remain the only standing security presence. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment based on background knowledge.

zones.description: Panga gold-mining area on the Aruwimi in the east of the territory (Panga health area, near Bafwasende border)
zones.evidence: Artisanal gold-mining centre where FARDC and police elements are present around mining sites; poachers/bandits and Mai-Mai remnants from neighbouring Bafwasende and Mambasa have been reported historically but no armed group is known to hold the area. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment based on background knowledge.
